from collections import Counter
def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    div=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]==2]
    if not div:return g
    bg=Counter(v for row in g for v in row if v!=2).most_common(1)[0][0]
    pts=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c] not in (bg,2)]
    if not pts:return g
    rows={r for r,c in div}; cols={c for r,c in div}
    if len(cols)==1:
        dc=next(iter(cols)); lo=min(c for r,c in pts); hi=max(c for r,c in pts)
        shift=(dc+1-lo) if dc<lo else (dc-1-hi)
        moved=[(r,c+shift,v) for r,c in pts for v in [g[r][c]]]
        for r,c in pts:g[r][c]=bg
        for r,c,v in moved:g[r][c]=v
        marker=(min(c for r,c,v in moved)-1) if shift>0 else (max(c for r,c,v in moved)+1)
        if 0<=marker<w:
            for r in range(h):g[r][marker]=8
    elif len(rows)==1:
        dr=next(iter(rows)); lo=min(r for r,c in pts); hi=max(r for r,c in pts)
        shift=(dr+1-lo) if dr<lo else (dr-1-hi)
        moved=[(r+shift,c,g[r][c]) for r,c in pts]
        for r,c in pts:g[r][c]=bg
        for r,c,v in moved:g[r][c]=v
        marker=(min(r for r,c,v in moved)-1) if shift>0 else (max(r for r,c,v in moved)+1)
        if 0<=marker<h:
            for c in range(w):g[marker][c]=8
    return g
